thread.title: Roku, Verizon, and 3 More Midday Stock Movers

title: Roku, Verizon, and 3 More Midday Stock Movers
text:
Roku, Verizon, and 3 More Midday Stock Movers By Jan. 8, 2019 1:20 p.m. ET Order Reprints Illustration by Michael Haddad Text size
Hanging On . Stocks are on the rise again Tuesday, building on Monday’s optimism , and even the government shutdown, which stretched into its third week, couldn’t dampen the mood on Wall Street. Trade-sensitive names were leading the gains, as investors were feeling upbeat about ongoing tariff negotiations between the U.S. and China, after both sides said that the talks were making progress . However, tech may be more vulnerable after Samsung Electronics (005930. Korea) warned that fourth-quarter revenues would be light, in the wake of a similar announcement from Apple (AAPL) last week. Samsung dropped 1.7% in Asian trading, while Apple has gained 1.6% to $150.31.
The Dow Jones Industrial Average is up 167.5 points, or 0.7%, at 23,698.88 in recent trading, while the S&P 500 is 0.5% higher at 2561.68, and the Nasdaq Composite has gained 0.5% to 6861.46.
Midday Movers Monster Beverage (MNST) is up 6% to $52.72 after SunTrust upgraded it to Buy. Nokia (NOK) is up 1.6% to $6.12 after Raymond James upgraded it to Outperform. Verizon Communications (VZ) is up 2.6% to $58.19 after reporting fourth-quarter subscriber metrics . Williams Cos. (WMB) is up 2.4% to $24.72 after Bernstein upgraded it to Outperform.
